chunks: And ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn عليهما السلام, when he traveled to Mecca for hajj or ʿumrah, would take provisions from the finest supplies: almonds, sugar, and sawiq made sour and sweetened.

key_terms.أَطْيَبِ الزَّادِ: the finest and most pleasant provisions
key_terms.السَّوِيقِ: sawiq, roasted flour preparation used as travel food
key_terms.الْحَجِّ: hajj, the major pilgrimage to the Sacred House
key_terms.تَزَوَّدَ: he took provisions and prepared supplies for travel
key_terms.مَكَّةَ: Mecca, the destination of the sacred pilgrimage journey

ai.seo_question: What provisions did Imam ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn عليهما السلام take when traveling to Mecca for hajj or ʿumrah?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a practice of Imam ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn عليهما السلام during travel to Mecca for hajj or ʿumrah. It shows that he would prepare wholesome and fine provisions for the journey, reflecting care and proper readiness in acts of worship-related travel.
